scope: Independent source-photo appearance, face-material region, original-geometry preservation and final v5 ten-image visual review; not a new measured reconstruction or print/slicer certification.

visual_inspection.seven_full_views: Complete model and support visible; labels readable and outside model.
visual_inspection.three_detail_views: Intentional close-up crops; entrance stone/glazing, tower cap/platform and neutral roof treatment inspected.
resolved_findings: Higher rear gable no longer incorrectly masked pale stone.
Tower cap bluegreen slopes separated from gray seating.
Tower z49 horizontal platform uniformly gray; spurious front-wall triangular stone wedge removed.
Broad unverified rear roof and long/back faces remain uniform neutral, no centroid-created large triangular color patches.
source_supported_color_families: pale gray stone front gable and trim

limitations: Only the existing simplified model was colored; original proportions, geometry and unavailable rear facade details were not rebuilt.
Photographic color families are approximate, not calibrated measured colors or guaranteed current conditions.
Large rear roof, rear and long-side surfaces are explicitly unverified neutral.
Original coarse triangles limit small material boundaries; the brick-colored sloping tower shoulder is an existing distinct geometric surface, not a residual split of the z49 horizontal platform.
Six actually used materials do not constitute a tested four-filament project. STL remains uncolored; no physical print or slicer-import verification is claimed by this review.
Private reference photo is not a texture and must not enter the public package. Source rights are not reassigned.
other_validation: Builder delivery/format/rebuild/reopen checks are separate evidence; this independent report does not substitute for them.
